prompt: Call the 6-and-under tee-ball season opener like a WWE main event, commentary table and all.
response:
**LIVE FROM THE BACKYARD BALLPARK – THE SEASON OPENER HAS BEGUN!**

*(The camera pans across a sea of tiny folding chairs, juice boxes, and one confused golden retriever wearing a tiny batting helmet. Pyrotechnics that are definitely just sparklers taped to a folding table go off. JR and Tazz are somehow commentating from a plastic picnic table covered in a plastic tablecloth that says “Happy Birthday, Tyler!”)*

**JR:** BAH GAWD ALMIGHTY! Ladies and gentlemen, boys and girls, and all you sippy-cup warriors watching at home… WELCOME… TO TEE-BALL MANIA!

**Tazz:** The energy here is off the charts, JR! These kids got more heart than a Monday Night Raw main event, and twice the sugar intake!

**JR:** You’re damn right! In one corner, weighing in at a combined 187 pounds and 43 missing teeth… representing the East Side T-Ball Titans… led by that walking sugar-rush phenom, “The Tiny Terror” TIMMY “TOOTHLESS” THOMPSON!

*(Timmy runs to the plate dragging his bat like it’s a battle axe, helmet two sizes too big, tongue sticking out the side of his mouth.)*

**Tazz:** And his opponent! Hailing from right field where he sometimes just sits down and eats grass… the defending backyard champion… “The Juice Box Killer” JAXSON “CHAOS” CARTER!

*(Jaxson sprints in wearing a cape that is clearly his mom’s beach towel. He stops halfway to the plate to chase a butterfly.)*

**JR:** The bell has rung… or I think that was just a dad hitting a cowbell with a plastic hammer. Either way, we are underway!

**Tazz:** Timmy’s at the tee! He’s winding up… he’s got that classic herky-jerky motion we’ve seen break three windows this spring… HERE IT COMES!

*(CRACK – the ball falls straight off the tee and rolls three feet.)*

**JR:** GOOD GAWD THAT BALL IS LOOSE! It’s a grounder… it’s a slow roller… it’s practically a bunt by default!

**Tazz:** Little Jimmy at shortstop has it! He’s got it! He’s… he’s looking at the ball like he’s never seen one before. Oh no… he just put it in his pocket, JR. He just put the game ball in his cargo shorts!

**JR:** That’s a federal offense in this league! The umpire—wait, that’s just Timmy’s dad in a lawn chair—is waving his arms! We’ve lost control of this match!

**Tazz:** Meanwhile Jaxson is running to first base… he’s running to second… he just ran straight through second and he’s now in the outfield picking dandelions. This kid’s got the attention span of a goldfish on Red Bull!

**JR:** Here comes the Titan’s enforcer—little Emily, age five and a half, known as “The Enforcer” because she will absolutely take your snacks if you look at her wrong. She’s charging the ball like it owes her money!

*(Emily boots the ball unintentionally. It rolls toward the fence. Three kids immediately chase it like it’s the Holy Grail.)*

**Tazz:** We’ve got a pile-up at the center field fence! That’s a five-kid pile-up! Someone’s crying… someone’s laughing… I think that’s pee, JR. I’m pretty sure that’s pee.

**JR:** The referee is counting… but these kids don’t know what a three-count is! They think he’s just playing “this little piggy”!

**Tazz:** WAIT A MINUTE! Here comes the run rule! Little Sophie from the Titans just crossed home plate while the entire other team was doing the Macarena by the snack table!

**JR:** SHE’S DONE IT! SOPHIE JUST SCORED THE SEASON’S FIRST RUN! THE TITANS ARE UP 1-0 AND THE PLACE IS ERUPTING! THE MOMS ARE SCREAMING! THE DADS ARE PRETENDING THEY’RE NOT CRYING!

**Tazz:** Jaxson is still smelling flowers in the outfield. He has no idea the game is happening.

**JR:** BAH GAWD, what a main event! What a way to kick off the 6-and-under season! These kids didn’t just play tee-ball tonight… they waged WAR!

**Tazz:** And we’re only in the first inning. Lord have mercy.

**JR:** That’s all the time we’ve got, folks. For Tazz, this is good ol’ JR saying… somebody get that kid out of the tree, clean up that spilled Capri Sun, and we’ll see you next week for Tee-Ball Mayhem!

*(The camera cuts as two kids start hugging in the outfield while a third one tries to eat the baseball.)*
